description: Return a read-only plan for a target: compare it against the Workbench profile and list each component as `install`, `present`, or `manual`, with the commands that would run. It still runs a detection probe on the target (same access as inspect_target) but clones nothing and writes nothing. Parameter semantics: `components` restricts the diff to those ids (default: required+core); `workspace` sets the expected profile path on the target (default `~/opencode-workbench`); `profileUrl` overrides the git remote. Use it to preview before apply_clone, which performs the changes.

components.description: Component ids to include; defaults to required+core.

skipRepo.description: Do not clone/update the profile repo on the target.

target.description: The machine to operate on: this host (local) or a remote host over SSH (ssh).

mode.description: Run on this machine (local) or a remote host (ssh).

user.description: SSH user (defaults to ssh config / current user).

workspace.description: Target directory for the profile repo.

name: plan_clone

configDir.description: OpenCode config directory on the target.

dockerRunning.description: Whether the Docker daemon is reachable.

envPresent.description: Space-separated names of credentials present on the target (values are never read).

has.description: Detection flags for git, curl, node, npm, corepack, pnpm, docker, uv, gh, opencode, sudo.

opencodeBin.description: Path to the opencode binary, if installed.

packageManager.description: Detected package manager (apt-get, dnf, yum, apk, pacman, zypper, or none).

workspaceDefault.description: Default directory where the profile repo will be cloned.

action.description: Planned action: install, already present, or manual step.

command.description: Preview of the privileged command that would run, for consent.

toInstall.description: Component ids that will be installed.

title: Plan a Workbench clone
